sentences.en: That it be with the off-the-radar Sue of all people!
sentences.zh: 竟然会是那个低调行事的苏！

sentences.en: They sue companies that sell MP3 players without paying them.
sentences.zh: 他们起诉那些不付钱就卖MP3播放器的公司。

sentences.en: Sue is the best tennis player in our school.
sentences.zh: 苏是我们学校最棒的网球选手。

senses.zh: 控告，控诉，和…打官司,请求,起诉,提起（诉讼）要求判决
